opening_lines.text: Bay Crowe. Bu saatte rahatsız ettiğim için özür dilerim.
opening_lines.en: Mr. Crowe. My apologies for disturbing you at this hour.
Doesn't matter. Edmund Harlow is dead.

opening_lines.speaker: INNER_VOICE
opening_lines.text: "Harlow. Bu ismi bir yerde duydum. Nerede?"
opening_lines.en: "Harlow. I've heard that name somewhere. But where?"

opening_lines.text: Köprü kapanıyor. Sabaha kadar kimse gelemez. Sabah olduğunda herkes kendi hikâyesini uydurmuş olacak.
opening_lines.en: The bridge is washing out. No one can reach here till morning. By daylight, everyone will have concocted their own story.

choices.caller_reply: Çünkü kapalı kapıların nasıl açıldığını bilen son kişisin. Kuzey'den beri.
choices.caller_reply_en: Because you are the last man who knows how locked doors open. Not since the North.
choices.inner_voice: "Kuzey mi? Bu kelimeyi ağzına nasıl aldı?"
choices.inner_voice_en: "The North. How did that word cross their lips?"

choices.caller_reply: Başka kimse yok, Crowe. Hiç olmadı.
choices.caller_reply_en: There is no one else, Crowe. There never was.
choices.inner_voice_en: "That voice... it carries a fatigue I recognize all too well."

choices.caller_reply: Yarın çok geç olacak. Geç kaldığımız bir şey zaten var, hatırlıyor musun?
choices.caller_reply_en: Tomorrow will be too late. We're already late for something else, remember?
choices.inner_voice_en: "I don't remember. Or perhaps I choose not to."

closing_lines.en: You must go before the bridge washes out. Before your time runs out.

closing_lines.speaker: SYSTEM
closing_lines.text: [Hat kapanır. Ahizeden sadece ritmik bir tik tak sesi gelir. Silas cep saatine bakar: 03:12.]
closing_lines.en: [The line goes dead. Only a rhythmic ticking comes through the receiver. Silas glances at his pocket watch: 03:12.]

closing_lines.speaker: INNER_VOICE
closing_lines.text: "Saat durmuş... ama telefonun ucunda biri tik tak diyordu."
closing_lines.en: "The watch is frozen... yet someone on the other end was whispering tick tock."
